additional_notes: - Slightly increased seismicity under Vatnajökull, between Grímsvötn and Bárðabunga. - Conductivity in the river Múlakvísl (SE of Mýrdalsjökull, Katla) decreasing to normal background level after being higher than usual throughout the last weeks.

entries.status_text: About 50 earthquakes were detected in the past week, largest M5.2 on 19 October without further escalation.
On 15 October a minor seismic swarm was detected were about 25 earthquakes (max M0.9) was measured. Since then minor seismicity has been recorded. Last swarm was detected on 9 August.

Ground uplift continues at a slow and steady rate beneath Svartsengi. In the past 3 months about 5 cm of uplift has been measured. Seismic activity along the dike region is low. The most likely scenario continues to be that a magmatic dike will propagate from Svartsengi towards the Sundhnúkur crater row, which can result in an eruption. The Icelandic Met Office hazard assessment is valid until 5 January 2027 and remains unchanged.
